title: AMD vs NVIDIA GPU Equivalents: Chart for Every Radeon Card
description: The RX 9070 XT roughly equals an RTX 5070 Ti and the RX 6700 10GB an RTX 4060 in raster games. Find the NVIDIA match for every Radeon, RX 580 to RX 9000.
dek: Find the closest GeForce card to any Radeon, from the RX 9070 XT back to the RX 580, with the ray-tracing catch spelled out.
quickAnswer: In raster games, the RX 9070 XT is roughly an RTX 5070 Ti, the RX 9060 XT 16GB an RTX 5060 Ti 16GB, the RX 6700 XT an RTX 3060 Ti, the RX 6700 10GB an RTX 4060, the RX 6600 XT an RTX 3060, and the RX 580 a GTX 1060 6GB. With ray tracing on, each Radeon falls one or more NVIDIA tiers lower.
intro: This chart matches every recent Radeon card to the GeForce card that performs most like it in traditional raster games, the kind most people still play. It covers RX 9000, RX 7000, RX 6000, RX 5000 and the RX 500 series, with a separate column for ray tracing, where the match usually changes.

Equivalents are based on the broad pattern of published independent reviews, rounded to the nearest card. We have not bench-tested these GPUs. Expect any single game to swing a few percent either way.

sections.h: How to Read This Chart, and Why Ray Tracing Changes It
body: Each row shows the NVIDIA card with the closest average raster performance at the resolution the AMD card was built for: 1080p for entry cards, 1440p for mid-range and up. Roughly means within about 5 to 10 percent on average. When an AMD card sits between two NVIDIA cards, both are listed.

The ray tracing column shows the NVIDIA card it behaves more like once RT effects are turned on. AMD's RX 9000 cards narrowed the gap a lot, but on older Radeons heavy ray tracing can drop them two or three NVIDIA tiers.

Raster equivalence also ignores features. NVIDIA RTX cards get [DLSS](/glossary/dlss/), and RX 9000 cards get FSR 4; older Radeons are limited to FSR 3.1. VRAM differences matter too: when two cards are equal in speed, the one with more memory will age better.

Because NVIDIA and AMD put different amounts of hardware into [ray tracing](/glossary/ray-tracing/). NVIDIA has dedicated RT cores since the RTX 20 series and has added more capability each generation. AMD added ray accelerators with RX 6000, improved them with RX 7000, and made its biggest jump with RX 9000.

So a Radeon that matches a GeForce card with RT off will fall behind it with RT on, and the gap grows with the amount of ray tracing. A game with RT shadows only may show a small gap. A path-traced game can show a very large one. If you play RT-heavy games, use the ray tracing column, not the raster one, when you shop.

AMD's current RDNA 4 cards compete directly with NVIDIA's RTX 50 series, and the raster matches are tight. Ray tracing is much better than on RX 7000 but still a tier behind the matching GeForce card.

sections.h: What Is the RX 9070 XT NVIDIA Equivalent?
body: The RX 9070 XT's NVIDIA equivalent is the RTX 5070 Ti. Independent reviews put the two roughly level in raster games at 1440p and 4K, and both carry 16 GB of VRAM. Against the older generation, it lands close to an RTX 4080 in raster.

With ray tracing, the [RX 9070 XT](/gear/rx-9070-xt/) behaves more like an [RTX 5070](/gear/rtx-5070/), and in path-traced games it falls further behind. That is the main reason the RTX 5070 Ti costs more. For the full trade-off, see [RTX 5070 Ti vs RX 9070 XT](/compare/rtx-5070-ti-vs-rx-9070-xt/).

sections.h: What Is the RX 9060 XT NVIDIA Equivalent?
body: The RX 9060 XT 16GB is roughly equal to the RTX 5060 Ti 16GB in raster games, and usually costs less. Ray tracing puts it closer to the RTX 5060. The 8 GB version performs similarly to the RTX 5060 Ti 8GB until a game runs out of video memory, which happens sooner at 1440p.

If you are choosing between the two 16 GB cards, read [RTX 5060 Ti 16GB vs RX 9060 XT 16GB](/compare/rtx-5060-ti-16gb-vs-rx-9060-xt-16gb/). If you are weighing it against the cheaper 8 GB RTX 5060, see [RTX 5060 vs RX 9060 XT 16GB](/compare/rtx-5060-vs-rx-9060-xt-16gb/).
RDNA 3 cards matched NVIDIA's RTX 40 series well in raster but fall further behind in ray tracing than RX 9000 does. They also cannot officially use FSR 4.

sections.h: What Is the RX 7800 XT NVIDIA Equivalent?
body: The RX 7800 XT's NVIDIA equivalent is the [RTX 4070](/gear/rtx-4070/). The Radeon is slightly faster on average in raster games and has 16 GB of VRAM against 12 GB. In raster it also lands close to an RTX 3080. With ray tracing on, it falls to about RTX 4060 Ti level.

In NVIDIA's current lineup, the [RTX 5070](/gear/rtx-5070/) is a little faster than the RX 7800 XT in raster and clearly faster with ray tracing, so it is not a worthwhile upgrade on its own. Moving to an [RX 9070 XT](/gear/rx-9070-xt/) or RTX 5070 Ti is.

The RX 6000 series is the most searched, because so many of these cards are in use or on the used market. In raster, RDNA 2 lined up with NVIDIA's RTX 30 series. In ray tracing, it is generally the weakest of the cards here, often landing two tiers below its raster match.

sections.h: What Is the RX 6700 10GB NVIDIA Equivalent?
body: The RX 6700 10GB's closest NVIDIA equivalent is the RTX 4060, which it matches or slightly beats in raster games. It sits between the RTX 3060 12GB and the RTX 3060 Ti: clearly faster than the first, a step behind the second. It is about 10 percent slower than the RX 6700 XT, which has more compute units and 12 GB.

The catch is ray tracing. With RT on, the RX 6700 falls below an RTX 3060, and it has no access to DLSS, so in RT-heavy games the RTX 4060 is the better experience despite having 8 GB. In raster games with high textures, the RX 6700's extra 2 GB gives it more headroom than the RTX 4060.
If you are upgrading from an RX 6700, a card that feels clearly faster starts around the [RX 9060 XT 16GB](/gear/rx-9060-xt-16gb/) or [RTX 5060 Ti 16GB](/gear/rtx-5060-ti-16gb/) tier.

sections.h: What Is the RX 6600 XT NVIDIA Equivalent?
body: The RX 6600 XT is roughly an RTX 3060 12GB: a bit faster at 1080p in most raster games, and closer to even at 1440p, where its 128-bit memory bus and 32 MB cache become a limit. In ray tracing it behaves more like an RTX 2060 or RTX 3050.

The plain RX 6600 is a step lower, slightly slower than the RTX 3060 but ahead of the RTX 2060. The RX 6650 XT, a higher-clocked refresh of the 6600 XT, lands close to the RTX 4060. The current RX 7600 performs about like a 6650 XT, so it is not a meaningful upgrade from any of them.

sections.h: What Is the RX 6600 NVIDIA Equivalent?
body: The [RX 6600](/gear/rx-6600/)'s NVIDIA equivalent is the RTX 3060 12GB, which is a little faster on average in raster games and has more VRAM. The RX 6600 is faster than an RTX 2060 and clearly faster than an RTX 3050. With ray tracing on, it performs closer to an RTX 3050.

Against NVIDIA's newer cards, the [RTX 4060](/gear/rtx-4060/) is roughly 20 to 25 percent faster in raster by the broad pattern of independent reviews, and the RTX 5060 faster again. Whether that is worth the extra money is covered in [RX 6600 vs RTX 4060](/compare/rx-6600-vs-rtx-4060/).

sections.h: What Is the RX 6800 XT NVIDIA Equivalent?
body: The RX 6800 XT's NVIDIA equivalent is the RTX 3080 10GB: the two have been roughly even in raster since launch, and the RX 6800 XT has 16 GB against 10 GB. Against the next generation it lands close to an RTX 4070. With ray tracing on, it falls to between an RTX 3060 Ti and RTX 3070.
The plain RX 6800 is a step lower, slightly faster than an RTX 3070 Ti in raster. Both are strong used buys for 1440p if you rarely turn ray tracing on.

sections.h: RX 5000, RX 500 and Vega NVIDIA Equivalents (RX 580 Included)
body: These cards have no ray-tracing hardware at all, so only raster applies. Driver support has also moved on: AMD moved RX 400, RX 500 and Vega cards to legacy support in late 2023, so they get critical fixes rather than regular game optimizations.

The RX 580 8GB is the classic rival to the GTX 1060 6GB, and the two remain roughly even. In today's NVIDIA lineup, every current card is far faster: even an RTX 5060 is roughly three times the RX 580's raster performance by the broad pattern of independent reviews. If you are still on an RX 580, almost any modern card under $350 is a large upgrade.

Check two things before upgrading an old system. First, the power supply: an RX 580 build often has a 500 W unit, which is fine for an RTX 5060 or RX 9060 XT but not for higher tiers. Second, the CPU: a Ryzen 5 2600 or Core i5 of the same era will hold back a modern card in many games. Our [GPU guide for the Ryzen 5 2600 and 3600](/best-gpu-for-ryzen-5-2600-and-3600/) covers that pairing, and the [bottleneck calculator](/tools/bottleneck-calculator/) shows how much headroom your CPU has.

sections.h: NVIDIA to AMD: Which Radeon Matches Your GeForce Card?
body: Going the other way, this table starts from the GeForce card you have, or are looking at, and lists the closest Radeon and Intel Arc card in raster games. The same rule applies in reverse: with ray tracing on, the NVIDIA card pulls ahead of its Radeon match.
The RTX 5090 and RTX 4090 have no AMD equivalent. AMD's fastest current card, the RX 9070 XT, sits level with an RTX 5070 Ti.

body: Intel's Arc cards slot into the same chart at the low and middle tiers. The Arc B580 roughly matches an RTX 4060 and is a little faster than an RX 7600 XT, the A750 lands near an RTX 3060 and RX 6600, and the A380 matches a GTX 1650. Arc holds up better than Radeon with ray tracing at the same tier, but it needs Resizable BAR and loses more performance on older CPUs.
The full chart, with every Arc card from the A310 to the B580, is in [Intel Arc GPU equivalents](/intel-arc-gpu-equivalents/).

mistakes: AMD and NVIDIA numbering does not line up. An RX 7600 is not an RTX 4070 rival because both end in 70 or 600. Use the chart, not the model number, when comparing cards.
Two cards with the same frame rate today can age very differently. The RX 6700 XT's 12 GB holds up better in new games than the 8 GB RTX 3060 Ti it roughly matches in raster.
The RX 6500 XT and RX 6400 use only four PCIe lanes. On a PCIe 3.0 motherboard they lose noticeable performance, so the GTX 1650 class match only holds on PCIe 4.0 boards.
Using raster equivalents for RT games
If Cyberpunk 2077, Alan Wake 2 or another heavy RT title is the reason you are upgrading, compare using the ray tracing column. Raster parity can hide a large RT gap.
bottomLine: For raster gaming, the quick matches are: RX 9070 XT to RTX 5070 Ti, RX 9070 to RTX 5070, RX 9060 XT 16GB to RTX 5060 Ti 16GB, RX 7900 XTX to RTX 4080 Super, RX 7800 XT to RTX 4070, RX 6700 XT to RTX 3060 Ti, RX 6700 to RTX 4060, RX 6600 XT to RTX 3060, and RX 580 to GTX 1060 6GB. With ray tracing on, drop each Radeon a tier or more, least for RX 9000 and most for RX 6000.

faqs.q: What is the RX 6700 10GB equivalent to in NVIDIA?
faqs.a: The RX 6700 10GB is roughly equivalent to an RTX 4060 in raster games, and slightly faster on average. It sits between the RTX 3060 12GB and RTX 3060 Ti. With ray tracing on it falls below an RTX 3060, and it cannot use DLSS.

faqs.q: What NVIDIA card is equal to the RX 6600 XT?
faqs.a: The RTX 3060 12GB is the closest match. The RX 6600 XT is a bit faster at 1080p in most raster games, while the RTX 3060 catches up at 1440p and is faster with ray tracing. The RTX 3060 also has 12 GB of VRAM against 8 GB.

faqs.q: What is the NVIDIA equivalent of the RX 9070 XT?
faqs.a: The RTX 5070 Ti. Independent reviews show the two roughly level in raster games, and both have 16 GB of VRAM. With heavy ray tracing, the RX 9070 XT performs closer to an RTX 5070, and the RTX 5070 Ti pulls ahead.

faqs.q: What is the RX 7600 equivalent to in NVIDIA?
faqs.a: The RTX 4060 is the closest match, with the RX 7600 a little slower on average in raster games. Both have 8 GB. The RX 7600 is faster than an RTX 3060 12GB in raster but closer to it with ray tracing on.

faqs.q: What is the RX 580 equivalent to in NVIDIA?
faqs.a: The GTX 1060 6GB. The two have been roughly even since launch. In NVIDIA's current lineup there is no direct match, because even the RTX 5060 is roughly three times faster in raster.

faqs.q: What NVIDIA card matches the RX 6700 XT?
faqs.a: The RTX 3060 Ti, roughly even in raster games. The RX 6700 XT has 12 GB against 8 GB, which helps with high textures, while the RTX 3060 Ti is faster with ray tracing and supports DLSS. The RTX 4060 Ti is also close in raster.

faqs.q: Are AMD GPUs worse at ray tracing than NVIDIA?
faqs.a: Yes, at each raster tier. RX 9000 cards closed much of the gap and usually perform like the NVIDIA card one tier below their raster match. Older RX 7000 and RX 6000 cards fall further behind, especially in path-traced games.

faqs.q: What AMD card is equal to the RTX 4070?
faqs.a: The RX 7800 XT, which is slightly faster in raster games and has 16 GB of VRAM against 12 GB. The RX 6800 XT is also close in raster. With ray tracing on, the RTX 4070 is about a tier ahead of both.
